questions.question: The maximum length of the femur is measured between which two points?

answers.a: Head of the femur and lesser trochanter
answers.b: Head of femur and medial condyle
answers.c: Most superior point of the head and most inferior point of medial condyle

explanations.a: Incorrect. The lesser trochanter is not used as a landmark for maximum femur length measurement.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Maximum length is not measured specifically to the medial condyle alone.
explanations.c: Correct. Maximum femur length is measured from the highest point on the femoral head to the lowest point on the medial condyle using an osteometric board.
explanations.d: Incorrect. These landmarks do not represent the maximum anatomical length of the femur.

questions.question: The standard instrument used to measure the maximum length of a femur is:

explanations.a: Incorrect. Sliding calipers are used for smaller linear measurements.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Vernier calipers are used for precise diameter and breadth measurements.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Measuring tapes are not suitable for accurate osteometric measurements.
explanations.d: Correct. An osteometric board is the standard instrument used to measure the maximum length of long bones such as the femur.

questions.question: Bicondylar length of the femur is measured from:

answers.a: Head of femur to medial condyle
answers.c: Head of femur to intercondylar notch
answers.d: Head of femur to a plane touching both condyles

explanations.a: Incorrect. Bicondylar length is not measured to a single condyle.
explanations.b: Incorrect. The greater trochanter is not used as the proximal landmark.
explanations.c: Incorrect. The intercondylar notch is not used in bicondylar length measurement.
explanations.d: Correct. Bicondylar length is measured from the highest point of the femoral head to a plane that touches both femoral condyles.

questions.question: The vertical diameter of the head of femur is important for determining:

explanations.a: Incorrect. Femoral head diameter is not primarily used for age estimation.
explanations.b: Correct. The vertical diameter of the femoral head is a commonly used parameter for sex determination because males generally have larger femoral heads than females.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Although population differences may exist, this measurement is primarily used for sex estimation.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Side determination relies on anatomical features rather than head diameter.
